Reachable keeps an element that an inline style hides, and never a script

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
use HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions;
$options = \HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions::from_json(json_encode(["hiddenContent" => "Reachable"]));
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<p>visible</p><div style=\"display:none\">collapsed body<script>var code = 1;</script></div>", $options);
var_dump($result->content);
```
